name: update_bookmark
title: Update Bookmark
description: Updates an existing bookmark's name, comment, and/or color. ImHex's bookmark API only supports add/remove, so this tool implements update as remove(old_id) + add(new_fields). The result includes both 'id' (the new bookmark id) and 'old_id' so the LLM can update its tracking. The address and size are NOT mutable in this version (use remove + add to relocate). [M] mutates the bookmark list.

id.description: ID of the bookmark to update

name.description: New name. If omitted or empty, the name is preserved (use the existing name if you want to keep it; omitting sets it to empty)

color.description: New RGBA color, or 0xFFFFFFFF to keep the existing color

id.description: New bookmark id (the old id has been removed)
